title: AI Spec Driven Development Toolkit Reference Project Charter
problem_statement: Deliver a schema-first, AI-collaborative toolkit that converts structured specifications into validated, running services with continuous assurance of correctness and performance across environments.
in_scope: Deterministic prompts that emit machine-checkable artifacts
CI workflows for validation, red-team, drift audit
out_of_scope: Domain-specific business logic beyond reference flows
assumptions: Teams can run CI; JSON editors available; repo access managed
Service language and framework are pluggable
risks: Spec drift if governance is bypassed

user_segments.description: Internal platform teams adopting spec-first delivery.
